The tag loads on demand (owner, 2026-10-26, from the review): js/sutra-tag.js (2,823 bytes) is out of the static import graph of js/app.js and counts here only as a precached file; the views draw through js/sutra-tag-slot.js (new, 703 bytes), which holds the tag's place until the module is here and is loaded a second after the page has loaded. The static graph is 1,768 bytes smaller than with the tag imported statically (295,631 to 293,863 bytes, 57 modules); the total grows 1,227 bytes over that version (806,122) for the slot module, its calls and the placeholder styles. Growth over main: js/app.js, js/star.js, js/arena.js, js/mental.js, js/try.js, math.css; measured on main as of #131, so that code is the only growth
